description: This is the main entry point source file for a Swift command-line application called Swabble. It handles CLI command parsing and dispatching to various subcommands related to the Swabble application, such as 'mic', 'service', 'serve', 'transcribe', 'test-hook', 'doctor', 'setup', 'health', 'tail-log', 'start', 'stop', 'restart', and 'status'. It uses async functions and the Commander library for CLI command management.

methods.name: runCLI
methods.description: Main CLI execution function that sets up the program and handles errors.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches the main command based on the first argument.

methods.name: swabbleHandlers
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of subcommand handlers for 'swabble'.

methods.name: subcommand
methods.description: Extracts a subcommand from the command line path at the specified index.
